answer_1.quote: Dialogizer is a novel framework designed to generate contextually relevant ConvQA datasets of high quality from textual sources... The framework incorporates two training methodologies, in addition to dialog reconstruction, to address the limitation of generating contextually-irrelevant questions.

answer_2.quote: we assess the generated datasets using diverse reference-free metrics that gauge distinct aspects of the dialog or generated questions.

answer_3.quote: Additionally, we utilize the GPT-4 model from official website of OpenAI for GPT-4 evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation involves three crowd workers per question... We use three criteria, i.e., contextual relevance, well-formedness, and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were instructed to judge each generated question on contextual relevance, well-formedness, and overall quality.
